_help: Edit ~/.config/lockscreen-extras/quotes.json (this copy). It is re-read every time the lock screen picks a quote.
A quote is either "text" or {"text": "...", "by": "..."}. A rule's "by" applies to all its quotes.
month 1-12|[..]; hours [from,to) 24h, wraps e.g. [22,5]; monthDay n|"first"|"last";
nthWeekday {"n":2,"weekday":"tue","month":10} (n=-1: last); dayOfYear n (negative: from year end);
event "substring"|[..] matched against today's GNOME Calendar events; anyEvent true|false.
Priority (default 10): the highest matching rule at >= 50 takes over (special day). Below 50, every
matching rule blends with "general"; "weight" n makes a blended rule n times more likely.
Movable festivals (Diwali, Holi, Ugadi...) come from your calendar: add a holidays calendar in GNOME
Calendar/Online Accounts, or add a dated rule here, e.g. "date": "2027-01-01".
